policy.script_suitability: Script loading and starting are revision agnostic. Users determine suitability for their chosen revision and platform; host/client boundaries refuse unsupported operations. This evidence ledger is not a loading or starting allowlist.
policy.foreign_script_defects: Operator clarified 2026-09-11: preserve host behavior; dim a demonstrably broken imported script with source identity, failure evidence and a clear reason. Keep the original inventory/history. Do not dim a host/shim bug or alter host semantics to accommodate foreign-script defects.
policy.ancillary_feature_stubs: Ancillary dependencies such as clue solving remain honest stubs for separate future native host feature projects; integrate through the shim when those host features exist. Such unavailable ancillary scope alone does not dim an otherwise working card. Preserve the deferred branch refusal policy; no imported foreign planners or fabricated completion.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Way out

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Spare escape casts

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Target NPC name(s)
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: comma-separated exact in-game names to fight, e.g. Guard, Knight, Moss giant

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Killing spot
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: use the tile where the script starts, or walk to custom coordinates

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Combat style
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: melee / mage / range. Older saves that stored attack/strength/controlled/defence under this key are migrated to Melee style.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Melee style
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: which melee stat to train; re-applied each login since com_mode is not saved

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Use special attacks
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: arms the spec bar whenever energy covers the wielded weapon's special (dragon dagger, dragon longsword, magic shortbow, …); does nothing with a weapon that has no special

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Autocast spell
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: kept armed via autocast — a staff must be wielded

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Casts of runes per bank trip
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: the bot tops runes up to this many casts of the selected spell; runes the wielded staff provides free are skipped

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Bank for ammo below %
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: when not banking for food, go bank once magic casts / ranged ammo drop below this percentage of a full trip

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Loadout
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: gear and supplies to wear, defined in the Loadouts panel; blank uses the first one

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Food to eat
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: exact item name to eat (e.g. Shark, Monkfish, Trout). Leave blank to use the loadout’s food, falling back to Trout

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Loot item names (contains)
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: defaults to gem-table items + clue scrolls, nothing else

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Loot entry mode
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: List = add items one at a time (current). CSV = paste a comma-separated list with copy/paste buttons.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Herbs to avoid
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: pick herbs to never pick up; matched by item id for grimy and cleaned forms, since every grimy herb reads as "Herb"

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Bury regular bones
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: pick up and bury regular Bones for Prayer XP (always looted when on)

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Banking
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: Auto = bank loot at the nearest bank and return; None = no loot-only bank trips

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Bank every N minutes
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: 0 = never. Same idea as CowKiller: walk loot to the bank after this many minutes so a death does not wipe a long session.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Melee style
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: which melee stat to train; re-applied each login since com_mode is not saved

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Staff
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: wielded staff, withdrawn from bank when missing

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Casts of runes per bank trip
Spare runes per type
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: withdrawn on top of the cast budget. Looted runes (fire giants drop chaos) let the trip cast past its planned count and drain whichever rune is scarcest — if that rune is also the escape teleport's, the bot cannot leave. Runes stack, so this costs no extra slots

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Bow
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: wielded bow, withdrawn from bank when missing

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Food to withdraw per bank run
Panic-to-bank below HP%
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: retreat to the bank when HP drops this low (out of food, or damage outpacing eating)

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Loot to pick up (drop table)
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: the fire giant drop table; ticked drops get grabbed. Everything picked up is banked — the bank keeps only food/runes/ammo/weapon plus the amulet, rope, and escape runes.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Bury big bones
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: bury Big bones for Prayer xp instead of banking them (always looted when on)

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Safespot tile (west room)
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: preferred spot in the west room — sees two giants. If one reaches it the bot drops to the fallback tile for a minute

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Safespot fallback tile
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: retreat tile used for a minute whenever a giant reaches the main safespot; must be somewhere no giant can path to

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Melee anchor tile (centre room)
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: centre of the east chamber — 7 giants within 6 tiles

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Way out
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: Barrel walks out through the dungeon door and rides the barrel off the ledge to 2527,3413 — free, no runes or magic level, 118 tiles from Ardougne West. A teleport only saves the walk back to the exit door

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Spare escape casts
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: casts carried on top of the one needed to leave

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Bank stand tile
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: left at the Seers default, this follows the escape teleport

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Coins target at restock
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: Runner: top coins up to this at each restock (boat fares + shop buy-backs). Unused by air.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Stay in the altar
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: Master and runner wait and trade inside the altar. Runners need a nature talisman.

settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Fletch mode
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: auto takes the job from the product, as it always has. cut fletches logs with the knife, string attaches bow string to unstrung bows, and cut+string does both in one trip: logs, then unstrung, then strung. settings_and_behavior_branches.label: Fletch product
settings_and_behavior_branches.help: knife products open the make-menu; string products attach Bow string onto the unstrung bow for this log type; arrow products attach item-on-item (material/knife ignored)
